faqs.question: What does an AI consultant do for small businesses?
faqs.answer: An AI consultant helps small businesses identify AI opportunities, implement automation workflows, and train teams to use AI tools effectively for growth and efficiency.

faqs.question: How much does AI consulting cost for small business?
faqs.answer: AI consulting for small businesses typically ranges from $150-$300 per hour or $2,000-$10,000 per month depending on project scope and ongoing support needs.

faqs.question: What AI automation services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer AI workflow automation, custom AI dashboards, AI asset generation, social media management AI, and end-to-end AI implementation for US small businesses.

faqs.question: How long does AI implementation take?
faqs.answer: Most AI implementations for small businesses take 2-8 weeks depending on complexity, with initial automation workflows live within 2-4 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you serve businesses outside the USA?
faqs.answer: Our primary focus is US small businesses, but we can work with international clients on a case-by-case basis for AI consulting and automation projects.
